en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is (1) to acquire the ability to assess the quality of project documentation, implementation, maintenance and restoration of vegetation elements (VE) from the position of a green manager or implementer, (2) to acquire the ability to solve biological, technical, technological, economic and organizational aspects during processing project documentation VE.
